# Klikcy

> Remote-first U.S. web agency: websites, SEO and answer engine optimization, AI automation, apps and software, e-commerce, branding, and hosting.

## About

Klikcy designs and builds fast websites and online stores, improves visibility on Google and in AI assistants, automates repetitive work with integrations and AI, and develops custom apps. The team works remotely with businesses in all 50 states and Washington DC and has no local offices.

How Klikcy works (confirmed by the business):
- A fixed, written quote before any work starts
- Clients own their code, domain, hosting, and analytics
- A progress update every week during projects
- Monthly plans that run month to month
- A reply within one business day
